styleDescription: Cozy whimsical storybook pixel art of a single fantasy critter as a 64x64 game sprite. Chunky, readable silhouette with round friendly shapes and big expressive eyes. Clean 1 px dark plum outline, soft 2-3 step shading lit from the top-left, small bright highlights, clean pixel clusters without dithering noise or blur. Muted, earthy realm palette. Transparent background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no frame.
